title: Smoke and dust cast shadows
summary: Smoke screens, dust clouds, fire columns, palls and road dust shade the ground, units and the sunlit haze beneath them, long and soft at golden hour.
stage: Game battle map (--aivai town square) off-screen, frozen at 26 s with FL_DEBUG_AIR_FLIP=26 FL_DEBUG_AIR_FLIP_SHADOW=1 FL_DEBUG_AIR_FLIP_SHOT, shadow off and on in the same frozen frame; motion clip from --write-movie of the same stage.
rationale: A shadow is a change in light on a still scene, so the evidence is the same frozen frame with the shadow off and on, OFF stacked over ON, at both sun heights the change matters for; a short clip shows the shadow following the drifting smoke without shimmer.
source_ref: c6f3be8a on dines/awesome-ramanujan-ac61b5 (Godot 4.7.2 Forward+, Windows, RTX 3090). Crops and labels: PIL; WebM: VP9 via Playwright ffmpeg.

measurements.golden_hour: 6.3% of the frame shadowed (light kept < 0.9); in it median 0.72, darkest 5% 0.38 of the unshadowed linear luminance; rest of frame 1.000
measurements.midday: 5.4% of the frame shadowed; median 0.76, darkest 5% 0.44; rest of frame 1.000
measurements.gpu: map draw 0.011 ms (viewport GPU time, 1440p Ultra); per-pixel lookup ~0.02 ms (16x amplified build: +0.06/+0.12/+0.92 ms means over 3 interleaved runs, /16); whole-frame interleaved A/B over 6 runs +0.26 +/- 0.14 ms mean, within the shared GPU's noise
